facts.text: The hotel is set along the Bosphorus waterfront in the historic district of Karaköy.
facts.excerpt: Set along the Bosphorus waterfront in the historic district of Karaköy

facts.text: The hotel is within Galataport, a new waterfront revitalisation project.
facts.excerpt: within Galataport, a new waterfront revitalisation project

facts.text: The hotel is made up of four buildings, three of them historic and restored.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is comprised of four exquisite buildings – three of them historic and beautifully restored

facts.text: The hotel welcomes guests arriving by land or sea.
facts.excerpt: welcomes guests arriving by land or sea

facts.text: Of the four buildings, two date from the early 20th century, one is a 1930s Bauhaus building and one is a new glass build, joined by corridors of Marmara marble.
facts.excerpt: two from the early 20th century, a 1930s Bauhaus beauty and a glassy new build, all seamlessly sewn together with corridors of Marmara marble

facts.text: Guests arrive at what was the former port's passport office.
facts.excerpt: guests arrive at what would have been the former port's passport office

facts.text: The Bauhaus ceiling at the arrival hall was restored with back-lighting by Turkish designer Zeynep Fadıllıoğlu.
facts.excerpt: magnificent Bauhaus ceiling brought back to luminous back-lit life by charismatic Turkish designer Zeynep Fadıllıoğlu

facts.text: The hotel is on the European side of the Golden Horn, which flows into the Bosphorus.
facts.excerpt: Set on the European side of the Golden Horn, which flows into the Bosphorus

facts.text: The Galata Tower stands behind the hotel.
facts.excerpt: see the Galata Tower which still stands sentry behind the hotel

facts.text: The Galataport waterfront complex includes a new underground cruise terminal and the Istanbul Museum of Modern Art.
facts.excerpt: the Galataport waterfront complex, which includes a new underground cruise terminal and the Istanbul Museum of Modern Art

facts.text: Rooms and suites across four waterfront buildings pair modern Turkish design with gardens, terraces and Bosphorus views.
facts.excerpt: Across four waterfront buildings, rooms and suites pair modern Turkish design with gardens, terraces and sweeping Bosphorus views

facts.text: Room headboards are inspired by the ochre stone blocks of Divriği Mosque in Anatolia.
facts.excerpt: headboards inspired by the ochre stone blocks of Divriği Mosque in Anatolia

facts.text: Rooms have subtle hyacinth motifs woven into mineral-blue rugs.
facts.excerpt: subtle hyacinth motifs woven into the mineral-blue rugs

facts.text: Grand Deluxe Rooms with Garden are ground-floor rooms in the most northerly heritage building, each with its own terrace surrounded by flowering shrubs and trees.
facts.excerpt: Each of these ground-floor rooms, set in the hotel’s most northerly heritage building, has its own terrace surrounded by flowering shrubs and trees.

facts.text: The Art Suite is adorned with original paintings, drawings, photographs and sculptures by contemporary and classical Turkish artists.
facts.excerpt: adorned with splendid original paintings, drawings, photographs, and sculptures from a variety of contemporary and classical Turkish artists

facts.text: The Peninsula Suite has a living room with a baby grand piano and a private hammam.
facts.excerpt: a spacious living room with a baby grand piano; a lavish private hammam

facts.text: The Peninsula Suite's private rooftop, with views over the Bosphorus and Galata Tower, has a private pool area and a glass-house solarium for dining and lounging.
facts.excerpt: private rooftop, with unobstructed views over the Bosphorus and Galata Tower encompasses both a private pool area and an exquisitely designed glass-house solarium for dining and lounging

facts.text: The Rooftop Garden Suite's living area has a telescope for gazing over the historical peninsula.
facts.excerpt: a living area with a telescope for gazing over the historical peninsula

facts.text: The rooftop restaurant Gallada is headed by chef Fatih Tutak.
facts.excerpt: Heading up The Peninsula Istanbul's grand, gorgeous rooftop restaurant, Gallada, is chef Fatih Tutak

facts.text: Gallada's menu is designed to take diners along the Silk Road, using Turkish ingredients and Chinese cooking techniques.
facts.excerpt: The menu has been designed to take diners along the Silk Road (Constantinople was one of the route's westerly endpoints), fuelled by Turkish ingredients and Chinese cooking techniques

facts.text: The Lobby is an all-day dining venue with Bosphorus views serving Mediterranean dishes from morning to evening.
facts.excerpt: Set beneath soaring ceilings with sweeping views of the Bosphorus, The Lobby is an elegant all-day dining destination. Offering refined Mediterranean dishes from morning to evening

facts.text: The Lobby serves daily Peninsula Afternoon Tea and Sunday Brunch, both of which can be enjoyed on the outdoor terrace with live music.
facts.excerpt: The Lobby also serves daily signature Peninsula Afternoon Tea, and sumptuous Sunday Brunch – both of which can be enjoyed on the tranquil outdoor terrace, and include music from live performers.

facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool right along the Bosphorus waterfront and an indoor pool surrounded by Marmara columns under illuminated domes.
facts.excerpt: The hotel boasts an outdoor swimming pool, situated right along the Bosphorus waterfront, as well as a showpiece, 25-m indoor swimming pool surrounded by Marmara columns and lit by a series of dramatically illuminated overhead domes.

facts.text: The Peninsula Spa occupies a marble-clad lower-level space in the hotel's main building.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Spa and Wellness Centre occupies a hushed, marble-clad lower-level space in the hotel’s main building.

facts.text: The spa has a white hammam inlaid with mother-of-pearl.
facts.excerpt: a glacier-white hammam inlaid with mother-of-pearl

facts.text: The spa has separate male and female suites with saunas, steam rooms and experience showers.
facts.excerpt: separate male and female suites with saunas, steam rooms and experience showers

facts.text: Elevators in each wing let guests go directly to the subterranean spa in their bathrobes.
facts.excerpt: Elevators in each wing allow guests to discreetly scoot to the subterranean spa in their Turkish linen bathrobes.

facts.text: Children are given a complimentary Camp Peninsula tent with treats.
facts.excerpt: Children are given a complimentary Camp Peninsula tent complete with treats.

facts.text: Peninsula Academy programs for children include a scavenger hunt for Byzantine treasures around the old city.
facts.excerpt: They can join Peninsula Academy programs, including a scavenger hunt for Byzantine treasures around the old city

facts.text: Pen Chat is a 24-hour private messaging e-concierge service.
facts.excerpt: Pen Chat, a 24-hour private messaging e-concierge service

facts.text: There is wheelchair access in all public areas, including the spa and swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: There is wheelchair access in all of the public areas, including the spa and swimming pools

facts.text: The hotel is 45 km from the airport.
facts.excerpt: 45.0 km / 27.9 miles

facts.text: The hotel has achieved the highest level of BREEAM certification for sustainability.
facts.excerpt: The hotel has achieved the highest level of BREEAM certification for its sustainability performance

facts.text: Istanbul guests will soon be able to arrive by a custom-made yacht also used for Bosphorus cruises.
facts.excerpt: Istanbul guests will soon have the option of alighting from a custom-made yacht, which will also be available for champagne-soak Bosphorus cruises

facts.text: The hotel says The Peninsula Suite offers the most opulent hotel accommodation in Istanbul.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Suite offers the most opulent and palatial hotel accommodation in Istanbul

facts.text: The official site lists The Peninsula Suite at 510 sq m / 5490 sq ft.
facts.excerpt: 510 sq m / 5490 sq ft

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes the split-level Peninsula Suite as 5920 square feet.
facts.excerpt: the split-level 5920-square-foot Peninsula Suite

contradictions.note: Official suite page gives 5490 sq ft; Conde Nast Traveler says 5920 sq ft
